datasets.title: STORM climate change tropical cyclone wind speed return periods
datasets.description: Gridded tropical-cyclone wind-hazard datasets giving maximum wind speeds at fixed return periods (and return periods at fixed wind speeds) at ~10 km resolution for each ocean basin, plus companion city/island tables within 100 km; values are derived using Weibull plotting formula from STORM climate-change simulations.
datasets.purpose: To provide consistent, high-resolution tropical-cyclone wind hazard metrics for present (1979-2014) and near-future (2015-2050) climates that support risk assessment, engineering design, and adaptation planning across basins and selected coastal cities and islands.
datasets.details: Datasets were generated with the statistical STORM algorithm using IBTrACS as the baseline and adding climate signals from four GCMs (CMCC-CM2-VHR4, CNRM-CM6-1-HR, EC-Earth3P-HR, HadGEM3-GC31-HM); outputs are distributed as netCDF (fixed return periods or fixed wind speeds, by basin) and Excel workbooks (cities/islands) including mean, standard deviation, and 5-95% confidence intervals.

sources.name: STORM - Synthetic Tropical cyclOne geneRation Model
sources.description: Global synthetic tropical cyclone dataset containing 10,000 years of simulated tropical cyclones under present-climate conditions. Generated using the STORM model with IBTrACS historical data and ERA5 environmental conditions as inputs. Includes TC position, maximum 10-minute sustained wind speeds (U10), mean sea-level pressure (MSLP), and radius to maximum winds (Rmax) at 3-hourly intervals.
sources.lineage: Synthetic dataset generated using STORM model with IBTrACS historical TC tracks (1980-2018) and ERA5 monthly-mean SST and MSLP fields as inputs. Model uses autoregressive formulas to simulate consecutive changes in TC position, pressure, wind speed, and eye size. Validated to preserve TC statistics within one standard deviation of IBTrACS observations.
